_comment: H-5 survival probe. ONE of YOUR OWN accounts, multiple captured sessions/credentials. Prefer NON-DESTRUCTIVE sensitive reads as the oracle (list withdrawal addresses, list API keys, full profile). Set the confirm flags true when satisfied. schedule_seconds sets when to re-probe after you trigger the revocation event; extend to 3600 for stronger evidence. The refresh-token probe is a POST, so it needs allow_state_changing=true (harmless: it just tries to mint a new token).

probes.label: refresh token / mint new access token (POST)
